#!/bin/bash
set -e
source /etc/network_turbo 2>/dev/null
PROXY="http://10.37.1.23:12798"
ARIA_OPTS="-x 16 -s 16 -k 10M --all-proxy=$PROXY --check-certificate=false --auto-file-renaming=false --allow-overwrite=true"
BASE="https://huggingface.co/openvla"

# Files to download per checkpoint
SMALL_FILES="config.json generation_config.json preprocessor_config.json special_tokens_map.json tokenizer.json tokenizer.model tokenizer_config.json added_tokens.json dataset_statistics.json model.safetensors.index.json README.md"
SHARD_FILES="model-00001-of-00004.safetensors model-00002-of-00004.safetensors model-00003-of-00004.safetensors model-00004-of-00004.safetensors"

for SUITE in spatial goal 10; do
    REPO="openvla-7b-finetuned-libero-${SUITE}"
    DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/${REPO}"
    mkdir -p "$DIR"
    echo "=== Downloading ${REPO} ==="
    
    # Download small files
    for f in $SMALL_FILES; do
        if [ ! -f "$DIR/$f" ]; then
            echo "  $f"
            aria2c $ARIA_OPTS -d "$DIR" -o "$f" "$BASE/$REPO/resolve/main/$f" 2>/dev/null || echo "  WARN: $f failed (may not exist)"
        fi
    done
    
    # Download shards
    for f in $SHARD_FILES; do
        if [ -f "$DIR/$f" ] && [ ! -f "$DIR/${f}.aria2" ]; then
            SIZE=$(stat -c "%s" "$DIR/$f")
            if [ "$SIZE" -gt 1000000 ]; then
                echo "  SKIP $f (already exists, ${SIZE} bytes)"
                continue
            fi
        fi
        echo "  Downloading $f..."
        aria2c $ARIA_OPTS -d "$DIR" -o "$f" "$BASE/$REPO/resolve/main/$f"
        echo "  DONE $f"
    done
    
    echo "=== DONE ${REPO} ==="
    echo ""
done

# Clean up .aria2 control files
find /root/autodl-tmp/openvla-7b-finetuned-libero-* -name "*.aria2" -delete 2>/dev/null
# Clean up HF cache incomplete files
rm -rf /root/autodl-tmp/openvla-7b-finetuned-libero-spatial/.cache/

echo "=== ALL CHECKPOINTS DOWNLOADED ==="
for SUITE in spatial goal 10; do
    DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/openvla-7b-finetuned-libero-${SUITE}"
    echo "${SUITE}: $(du -sh $DIR | cut -f1) total, $(ls $DIR/*.safetensors 2>/dev/null | wc -l) shard files"
done
DLEOF
chmod +x /tmp/download_all_checkpoints.sh
nohup bash /tmp/download_all_checkpoints.sh > /tmp/checkpoint_download_v2.log 2>&1 & echo "PID: $!"
